findings: The name-board matching activity is an illustrated classification worksheet, not a natural coherent grounding event.
Taro, Bob, and Errol are reduced to text cards, so their stable names are not grounded to depicted identities.
Page p3 is a five-name label parade.
Select the Ninereeds card is unlicensed learner-facing instruction and assumes an untaught selection convention.
The direct Who are you? item is answerable without attending to the story and therefore is application evidence, not story comprehension.
retry_rule: Keep the accepted thesis and substantive story task unchanged; create a fresh high-effort context and a new immutable output.
